SELECT d.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id, d.pref_name AS drug_name, di.mesh_heading AS indication_mesh_heading, di.efo_term AS indication_efo_term, di.efo_id AS indication_efo_id, di.mesh_id AS indication_mesh_id, di.max_phase_for_ind AS indication_max_phase
FROM molecule_dictionary d
INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON d.molregno = di.molregno
WHERE d.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND d.oral = 1 AND di.mesh_heading LIKE '%COVID-19%'
ORDER BY di.mesh_heading ASC
